title: FIFTH FIXED CALL FOR PROPOSALS UNDER THE PLAN FOR EUROPEAN COOPERATING STATES (PECS) IN MALTA
description: The European Space Agency and Xjenza Malta of the Republic of Malta hereby invite you to submit a proposal for the above Call for Proposals (CfP), which will be soon published in esa-star. While it is made visible to all ESA Member States, Associate Members and European Cooperating States, this CfP will be addressed only to legal entities of Malta that are registered in ESA-STAR. This CfP foresees the following standard activity types:Type A Research and Preparatory Activities, aimed at the preparation for participationin ESA optional programmes or the initial steps of a product development for Space, with potential for use on future ESA missions or commercial missions. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 175,000.Type B Flight- and Ground Segment-related Research and Development Activities, targetting equipment to build competences and capabilities centred on products or generic technology development with potential for re-use on ESA or commercial missions. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 400 000 (hardware development)/EUR 250 000 (all other activities).Type D Space science activities, supporting the involvement of national researchers leading to potential of future involvement in ESA science mission core team and publication of peer reviewed scientific papers. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 80,000.Type F Space (downstream) Applications, products and services making use of ESA/ European space infrastructure that is already existing or scheduled for operation in the near term. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 250,000. The work carried out by the Tenderer must be co-funded to a minimum level of 25% of the total cost of the activity.Type G1 University courses/modules leading to a qualification (BSc or MSc) in space related topics that correspond to the needs of national space industry and to encourage career in space and answer to national space industry needs. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 75,000.To be published as a separate tender in esa-star: Type G2 PhD Theses that correspond to a clear need from the national space industry and would lead to a new product or service being able to be developed. Maximum price for ESA: EUR 75,000 with a minimum company co-funding of EUR 10,000. More information and further programmatic constraints can be consulted in the cover letter of the call upon its issue date.

title: Indicators and Methods for Measuring Transition to Climate-neutral Circularity, its Benefits, Challenges and Trade-offs
description: The overall objective is to develop and test indicators that are fit for use with the new approaches suggested in the CEAP and the Green Deal and under Horizon Europe. These indicators must allow the measurement and assessment of the state of circularity, the transition towards it, and the social, environmental and economic impacts of this transition. This initiative shall bring together advanced approaches in environmental statistics with a life cycle analysis (LCA) approach and product environmental footprint methodology and data. The indicators shall allow knowledge gain about circularity at the levels of economy sectors, products, services, organisations, territories, individual households, along value chains, etc., and shall provide for the setting of benchmarks for policy, e.g. for funding.

title: Sistem informatic geospațial pentru Managementul integrat al infrastructurii Portului Constanta
description: Obiectivul general al proiectului il constituie adaptarea la cerintele si nevoile companiei prin implementarea unui sistem informatic geospatial respectandu-se principiile unei modernizari sustenabile si durabile. Mai jos sunt enumerate cateva obiective specifice ale proiectului: - dezvoltarea si implementarea unor instrumente de management centralizate, de comanda si de control de tip dashboard cu date esentiale si relevante reprezentate GIS, in vederea gestionarii eficiente a resurselor companiei; - implementarea de mecanisme de acces la date interne/externe care sa asigure interoperabilitatea cu diverse aplicatii si surse de date, prin crearea de interfete de intrare-iesire centralizate, standardizate si programabile - cresterea substantiala de calitate prin identificarea pe harta a obiectelor si inventarierea acestora, a diverselor informatii legate de fiecare cladire aflata in patrimoniul institutiei - reducerea riscurilor tehnologice prin crearea unei platforme hardware independent de producator, cat si a costurilor de mentenanta si adaptare la schimbarile tehnologice. Termenul limită până la care orice op. ec. interesat de participarea la procedura de achizitie publica are dreptul de a solicita clarificari sau informatii suplimentare in legatura cu DA este cu 18 zile inainte de termenul limită de depunere a ofertelor. EC stabileste 2 termene limită in care va raspunde tuturor solicit de clarif/ info. suplim, dupa cum urmeaza: • EC va raspunde într-un prim termen de 18 zile inainte de termenul limită de depunere a ofertelor tuturor solicitărilor de clarificare adresate de op. ec. in intervalul de la publicarea DA si până la data la care se implineste termenul cu 30 de zile anterior datei limită de depunere a ofertelor; • EC va raspunde într-un al 2-lea termen de 13 zile inainte de termenul limită de depunere a ofertelor restului de solicitări de clarificare adresate cu 18 zile anterior datei limită de depunere a ofertelor. EC isi rezerva dreptul de a publica raspunsurile la clarificări în acest al 2-lea termen pt care raspunsurile ar trebui publicate la primul termen indicat mai sus. Cele 2 termene de raspuns la clarificari nu afecteaza dreptul op. ec. de a adresa solicitari de clarificari pe parcursul intregii perioade care se scurge de la momentul publicării anuntului de participare si până la a 18-a zi anterior termenului limita de depunere a ofertelor stabilit de EC. La solicitarile adresate dupa acest termen entitatea contractanta nu va raspunde.
